entry.intro: Every round is about one of you. They answer two questions truthfully, everybody else makes an answer up, and then you all try to spot the truth. You get a code to share.

leaveConfirm: You will not be able to come back.

settings.total: {count} round in all with {players} players, and {questions} questions a round. | {count} rounds in all with {players} players, and {questions} questions a round.
settings.questionsEach: {count} question a round | {count} questions a round
settings.timeNote: When the time runs out an answer is made up for anybody who has not sent one, and a pick is made for anybody who has not picked.

table.sendAnswers: Send your answer | Send all your answers
table.pickOne: Pick the answer you believe is true
table.waitingForPicks: Waiting for the others to pick.

status.writeSubject: This question is about you. Answer it honestly: the others are making an answer up for the same one. | The questions are all about you. Answer them honestly: the others are making answers up for the same ones.
status.writeOther: Make up an answer that could pass for {name}’s own. | Make up an answer to each question that could pass for {name}’s own.
status.writeSent: Answers sent. Waiting for the others ({written} of {total}).
status.pickSubject: The others are picking which answer is really yours.
status.pickYours: Which of these is {name}’s own answer? You cannot pick your own.
status.pickWaiting: Picked. Waiting for the others ({picked} of {total}).
status.pickMatched: You wrote the true answer, so this one is already yours. Watch the others guess.
status.scoring: The true answer is worth {correct}; a made-up answer earns {fooled} for every player who picks it.
status.cannotPickOwn: Your own answer cannot be picked.
status.leaveToMenu: Use Leave game (top right) to go back to the menu.
status.finishedNote: Use Leave game (top right) to go back to the menu, or "All rounds" in the score bar to see every question again.
status.waitingReadyNext: Waiting for {names} to be ready for the next question.
status.waitingReadyFinal: Waiting for {names} to be ready for the final scores.
status.hurry: The time is nearly up: an answer will be made up for you.
status.hurryPick: The time is nearly up: a pick will be made for you.

log.roundStart: Round {n} of {total}: this one is about {name}.
log.fooled: {name} fooled {count} player with “{answer}”. | {name} fooled {count} players with “{answer}”.
log.spotted: Nobody spotted the true answer. | {count} player spotted the true answer. | {count} players spotted the true answer.

errors.alreadyAnswered: You have already sent your answers.
errors.answerEachQuestion: Answer the question. | Answer all {count} questions.
errors.typeAnswers: Write an answer to each question first.
errors.answerTooLong: An answer is at most {max} characters.
errors.answerNeedsWords: An answer needs some words in it.
errors.notTimeToPick: It is not time to pick an answer.
errors.subjectDoesNotPick: This round is about you, so you do not pick.
errors.notYourOwnAnswer: You cannot pick your own answer.
errors.yoursWasTrue: You wrote the true answer, so there is nothing for you to pick.
errors.questionsPerRound: Choose between {min} and {max} questions a round.
